q.compte: How do I create an account on Teranga Way?
q.compteR: No. You can browse everything freely. The code is only asked when you send a request.
q.delai: How quickly does the partner reply?
q.delaiR: Usually within the hour for a place to stay. If nobody replies within two hours, the request expires and we offer you something else.
q.paiementR: On arrival, directly to the partner, never before the stay. Cash, Wave or Orange Money depending on the partner. We never ask for a deposit or a bank card.
q.prix: Can the price change after my request?
q.prixR: No. The price is fixed the moment you send your request.
q.adresse: Why is the address not shown?
q.adresseR: The exact address and the partner's contact details appear after you confirm. It protects you as much as them.
q.annuler: Can I change or cancel my booking?
q.annulerR: Yes, from your request details. The partner's cancellation terms are on every listing before you send.
q.refus: What happens if my request is declined?
q.refusR: We immediately offer you other places available on the same dates.
q.taxi: How does the booked taxi work?
q.taxiR: Our team passes your request to a partner taxi. Their acceptance counts as confirmation: there is nothing else for you to do. The driver confirms the price.
q.deuxHeures: Why can't I book a ride straight away?
q.deuxHeuresR: Arranging a pick-up takes two hours. For an immediate need, call the team: they will find a way.
q.reserver: How do I make a booking?
q.reserverR: Pick a place or a vehicle, give your dates and send a request. The provider replies within two hours. Nothing is confirmed — or held — until they accept.
q.contacter: How do I contact a provider?
q.contacterR: Their contact details reach you once the request is accepted, not before. Until then, write from the request itself: your message gets through without either of you sharing a number.
q.securiteR: We only ask for what the booking needs: name, phone, email. No bank details pass through the platform, since you pay on arrival. If you are a provider, your supporting documents are not stored here.
q.probleme: What should I do if something goes wrong during my stay?
q.problemeR: Call support: it is the quickest way. For a medical emergency, the police or a fire, dial the emergency numbers directly — they are listed on the Emergencies page.
q.avis: How do I leave a review after my stay?
q.avisR: A review can only be left once a stay is over, from your account. That is what guarantees the reviews you read come from people who really stayed.
q.devenirPrestataire: How do I become a provider on Teranga Way?
q.devenirPrestataireR: Create a provider account in five steps. Our team calls you back, checks your supporting documents off the platform, then publishes your listing. Allow 24 to 48 hours.

public.aProposIntro: Teranga Way is the visitor platform for the 2026 Youth Olympic Games in Dakar. It brings together checked places to stay and checked transport, close to the Games venues.
public.aProposMissionTexte: We check every partner and every listing before publishing them. You search, you compare, you request: the partner replies, you confirm, and you pay on arrival.
public.regle1: Nothing is shown without being checked by two people on our team.
public.regle2: No online payment, no deposit. Ever.
public.regle3: The address and the contact details only appear after you confirm.
public.regle4: The price is fixed the moment you send your request.
public.aProposPartenaire: Do you offer a place or a vehicle?
public.aProposPartenaireTexte: Join the checked partners of the platform.
public.servicesIntro: Two services for V1, treated with the same care: finding where to sleep, and finding how to get around.
public.servicesLogementTexte: Hotels, residences, flats, villas, studios and rooms with a host. Every listing states its capacity, its amenities, its cancellation terms and its total price for your dates.
public.servicesTransportTexte: Rides with a driver at a fixed price, cars with a driver by the day, and taxis booked ahead. Vehicles are checked and drivers identified.
public.legalEditeurTexte: Teranga Way — visitor platform for the 2026 YOG in Dakar. Plateau, Dakar, Senegal.
public.legalRoleTexte: Teranga Way connects visitors with checked partners. The stay or transport contract is between you and the partner. We take no payment.
public.legalDonneesTexte: We keep your email or your number to identify you and to tell you about changes. Partners' supporting documents are not stored on the platform.
public.legalCookiesTexte: One session cookie, needed to follow your requests. No advertising cookie, no third-party tracker.
public.legalProprieteTexte: Olympic marks belong to their owners. Their use on this platform is subject to the written approval of the organising committee.
